Sanjay Raut Calls for Shiv Sena (UBT) Introspection

Shiv Sena (UBT) leader Sanjay Raut has called for introspection within the party. He stated that loyal party workers should not be taken for granted. This call comes amidst internal discussions about the party's direction and the treatment of its dedicated members.
